title: Send email with Groundmail
description: Send transactional email through Groundmail with HTML, text or a saved template, and an idempotency key so a retry sends once.

environment.name: GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY
environment.description: API key (gm_...) from app.groundmail.dev/api-keys. A gm_test_ key runs sends without delivering them. Keep it server-side.

environment.name: GROUNDMAIL_FROM
environment.description: Default sender on a verified domain, for example Acme <hello@yourdomain.com>. A request can set another in from.

environment.name: GROUNDMAIL_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: POST to and subject with html or text, or a saved template with variables; optionally from, reply_to and tags. An Idempotency-Key header makes a retry return the first send.
